records.translation: MarlonsTheme/21 9/farmer -100 -100 0 Marlon 23 6 2/addQuest 14/skippable/pause 1000/move Marlon 0 2 2/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 4/pause 1000/speak Marlon "嗯……"/pause 500/warp farmer 18 13/playSound stoneStep/move farmer 0 -3 1/move farmer 5 0 0/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 0/pause 500/speak Marlon "……我剛才正在往這口老礦井裡看。#$b#這裡已經荒廢幾十年了。"/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 4/speak Marlon "不過，下面應該還有好礦石。#$b#但這麼陰暗的地方，又長久未受打擾……恐怕你會找到的不只有礦石……"/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 0/pause 500/speak Marlon "來，拿著。你或許用得上。"/pause 500/playSound dwop/faceDirection farmer 1 true/pause 50/faceDirection farmer 2/itemAboveHead sword/pause 3300/awardFestivalPrize sword/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 1 true/pause 100/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 500/speak Marlon "對了，我叫馬龍。我經營的冒險者公會就在外面。#$b#我會關注你的表現。證明自己的實力後，我或許會考慮讓你加入。"/pause 500/end

continue/-1000 -1000/farmer 23 24 3 Haley 22 24 1/makeInvisible 23 24/addQuest 127/addConversationTopic haleyCakewalk2 0/skippable/viewport -100 -100 true unfreeze/pause 3000/speak Haley "嗨，親愛的。#$b#嘿……我有個點子……想召集大家舉辦一場慈善蛋糕健走。"/pause 500/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/speak Haley "呃……有點像大風吹，但每個人都是贏家，都能拿到蛋糕！到時你就知道了……$h#$b#活動會在下一個晴天於城鎮廣場舉行。#$b#呃……可以麻煩你帶一個巧克力蛋糕嗎？"/quickQuestion 你答應帶巧克力蛋糕嗎？#答應#不情願地答應(break)speak Haley "太好了！如果天氣允許，明天在城鎮廣場見。$h"\animate Haley false true 100 28\animate farmer true true 100 101\positionOffset Haley 8 0\positionOffset farmer -8 0(break)emote Haley 12\speak Haley "這種挖苦的態度是怎麼回事？$3#$b#好吧。明天帶著巧克力蛋糕出現，不然你就去睡狗屋。這樣比較合你意嗎？$3"/pause 2000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/end dialogue Haley "我會帶粉紅蛋糕。"

pause 100/faceDirection farmer 0/emote farmer 28/pause 1000/emote Harvey 12 true/emote Sebastian 12 true/emote Shane 12 true/emote Sam 12 true/emote Elliott 12 true/emote Alex 12 true/speak Harvey "這招沒用！這次你別想利用我們的同情心！$a"/speak Alex "我就當作這只是另一場戲……$a^果然不出所料……$a"/pause 100/speak Sebastian "你得為自己的所作所為負責……$a"/pause 1000/faceDirection Sam 2/playMusic none/speak Sam "……我想我們已經有結論了……對吧，各位？$u"/pause 500/speak Harvey "……是的。$s"/speak Sebastian "當然。$a"/faceDirection Sam 3/pause 1000/jump Sam/jump Sebastian/jump Elliott/jump Shane/jump Alex/jump Harvey/pause 1000/jump Sam/jump Sebastian/jump Elliott/jump Shane/jump Alex/jump Harvey/pause 1000/jump Sam/jump Sebastian/jump Elliott/jump Shane/jump Alex/jump Harvey/pause 1000/speak Sam "我們全都不會再理你了！$a"/faceDirection farmer 2 true/animate farmer false true 100 94/jump farmer/playSound slimedead/pause 2000/fade/viewport -2000 -2000/dump guys 4/end warpOut

50s/35 9/farmer 31 13 0 Abigail 34 9 1 Caroline 35 9 3/skippable/move farmer 0 -1 0/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 0/speak Abigail "別再告訴我該怎麼過自己的人生！$a"/pause 500/speak Caroline "嘿，夠了！我們讓你免費住在這裡直到畢業。看來你根本一點都不感激！$u"/emote Abigail 12/speak Abigail "別想讓我產生罪惡感。$a#$b#我很感激你和爸爸幫助我，但要求我照你的意思穿衣服，實在太荒謬了。$a#$b#媽媽，我已經不是小女孩了。$u"/faceDirection Caroline 1/pause 1500/faceDirection Caroline 3/speak Caroline "……你說得對。對不起。$s"/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 2/playSound woodyStep/faceDirection Abigail 2 true/faceDirection Caroline 2/speak Abigail "那裡有人嗎？$7"/faceDirection farmer 0/speed farmer 4/move farmer 0 1 3/speed farmer 4/move farmer -4 0 2 true/move Abigail -3 0 2 false/emote Abigail 8/speak Abigail "我發誓，這棟房子鬧鬼。"/emote Caroline 40/pause 500/end dialogue Abigail "呃啊……$a#$b#抱歉……我之前在跟媽媽吵架。$s"

pause 500/playMusic ocean/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/loadActors MainEvent/addTemporaryActor Governor 16 32 35 10 2/warpFarmers 33 19 0 32 19 0 40 19 0 28 9 1 42 9 3 37 19 0 38 19 0 34 19 0 right 36 6 2/viewport 35 12 true/pause 2000/faceDirection Lewis 3/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 2/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 1/pause 100/faceDirection Lewis 2/speak Lewis "各位，又到了百家湯儀式的時間。#$b#相信大家今年放進鍋裡的都是高品質食材。我們可不想讓州長後悔造訪山谷！"/pause 1000/faceDirection Lewis 3/pause 500/speak Lewis "那麼……州長？能否請您賞光品嘗這碗湯？"/pause 500/speak Governor "當然！我一整年都在期待。"/playMusic none/pause 500/move Governor 0 1 2/pause 1000/playSound dwop/showFrame Governor 8 true/pause 1000/animate Governor false false 200 8 8 9 10 11 11/pause 1100/playSound sipTea/pause 1000/playSound gulp/pause 500/showFrame Governor 8 true/animate Governor false false 200 11 10 9 8/pause 900/speak Governor "……$h"/pause 300/cutscene governorTaste/null

ragtime/-1000 -1000/farmer 16 20 1 Haley 18 16 0/skippable/showFrame Haley 20/shake Haley 500/viewport 15 16 true/pause 500/shake Haley 500/pause 500/speak Haley "嗯嗯嗯……我就是打不開這個罐子！$a#$b#……$s"/pause 400/shake Haley 500/move farmer 0 -4 1/shake Haley 500/move farmer 1 0 1/pause 500/faceDirection Haley 3 true/showFrame Haley 21/emote Haley 16/speak Haley "哦！是你……@，對吧？"/pause 1000/speak Haley "$q 47 null#話說……你力氣很大，對吧？#$r 47 30 Event_jar1#對#$r 47 -30 Event_jar2#不對"/faceDirection Haley 3/animate farmer false true 100 111/pause 400/playSound fishingRodBend/startJittering/pause 500/stopJittering/pause 200/playSound fishingRodBend/startJittering/pause 500/stopJittering/pause 200/playSound fishingRodBend/startJittering/pause 2000/stopJittering/playSound coin/stopAnimation farmer/animate farmer false true 100 112/jump farmer/pause 1500/pause 200/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 1/showFrame Haley 21/speak Haley "嘿，你打開了！你的力氣比看起來大！$h"/pause 400/emote farmer 12/pause 500/emote Haley 20/pause 500/speak Haley "謝啦！$h"/pause 500/end

pause 100/textAboveHead Haley "我很懷疑……"/pause 500/resetVariable/question fork2 "#我以為我們只是朋友！不知道事情這麼認真！#皮耶逼我的！他想多賣幾束花！#各位女士，這完全正常！只是一種生活方式的選擇……"/pause 100/fork lifestyleChoice/textAboveHead Haley "騙人！"/textAboveHead Maru "才怪！"/speak Emily "你真的以為我們會相信嗎？你只會越描越黑……$a"/pause 1000/faceDirection Haley 2/playMusic none/speak Haley "……我想我們已經有結論了……對吧，姊妹們？$u"/pause 500/speak Penny "……是的。$s"/speak Leah "當然。$a"/faceDirection Haley 3/pause 1000/jump Haley/jump Abigail/jump Emily/jump Leah/jump Maru/jump Penny/pause 1000/jump Haley/jump Abigail/jump Emily/jump Leah/jump Maru/jump Penny/pause 1000/jump Haley/jump Abigail/jump Emily/jump Leah/jump Maru/jump Penny/pause 1000/speak Maru "我們全都不會再理你了！$a"/faceDirection farmer 2 true/animate farmer false true 100 94/jump farmer/playSound slimedead/pause 2000/fade/viewport -2000 -2000/dump girls 4/end warpOut

50s/6 15/farmer 4 19 0 Sam 17 13 0 Jodi 7 4 0 Kent 3 15 1/removeItem 136/removeQuest 22/pause 300/faceDirection Kent 2/speak Kent "嗨，@。請進。"/move farmer 0 -3 0/speed Jodi 4/move Jodi 0 10 2/speak Jodi "啊，真高興你來了，@！而且還帶了魚！太好了。"/move farmer 2 0 0/move farmer 0 -1 1/faceDirection Kent 1/faceDirection Jodi 1/speak Jodi "山姆！可以進來幫忙清理這條魚嗎？"/pause 300/speak Sam "……好的，媽。$a"/move Sam -5 0 3 true/proceedPosition Sam/stopAnimation farmer/doAction 12 14/move Sam 0 2 3 false/move Sam -4 0 3/faceDirection Jodi 2/pause 500/showFrame 35/addObject 7 15 136/playSound fishSlap/pause 800/stopAnimation farmer/speak Jodi "哇，看起來真棒……聞起來也很新鮮！非常感謝你這麼做，@。#$b#肯特也抓了一條魚，但他一個人就能吃掉差不多一整條！$u"/pause 200/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 1000/speak Kent "嘿嘿。$h"/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 1000/message "嗯……香酥鱸魚太美味了！外層的麵衣好吃得要命……"/pause 500/message "現在我幾乎覺得自己是這個家的一分子了。"/pause 1500/end warpOut

records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 15 2 Marnie 65 16 0 pet 63 16 2/skippable/faceDirection PetActor 1/pause 500/animate PetActor false false 120 20 21 22 23 23/pause 480/animate PetActor false true 120 23/pause 2000/speak Marnie "你好，@！$h#$b#看到這隻狗了嗎？"/faceDirection Marnie 3/pause 400/showFrame PetActor 26/playPetSound dog_bark/pause 200/showFrame PetActor 23/pause 600/showFrame PetActor 26/playPetSound dog_bark/pause 200/showFrame PetActor 23/pause 1000/animate PetActor false true 200 24 25/playPetSound dog_pant/pause 400/playPetSound dog_pant/pause 400/playPetSound dog_pant/pause 1200/faceDirection Marnie 0/speak Marnie "我發現牠坐在你農場入口外！應該是隻流浪狗……真可憐。$s"/pause 500/animate PetActor false true 400 23 31/pause 1500/speak Marnie "嘿，牠好像很喜歡這裡！嘿，嗯……你不覺得農場需要一隻好狗嗎？$h"/catQuestion/pause 1000/faceDirection Marnie 3/speak Marnie "好了，%pet……要乖乖的……好嗎？"/pause 500/stopAnimation PetActor/showFrame PetActor 26/playPetSound dog_bark/pause 200/showFrame PetActor 23/pause 1000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/end

SunRoom/-1000 -1000/farmer -100 -100 0 Emily 15 18 2 Haley 12 18 2 Abigail 14 20 2 Caroline 13 20 2 Marnie 16 20 2/skippable/positionOffset Haley 0 32/showFrame Emily 54/showFrame Marnie 35/showFrame Haley 34/hideShadow Haley true/showFrame Abigail 53/showFrame Caroline 24/addObject 14 21 66 1/addObject 16 21 70/addObject 12 19 68 1/addObject 15 19 64 1/addObject 13 21 60 1/viewport 14 19 true/pause 4000/speak Emily "很好……每個人都拿到自己的石頭了。#$b#現在，閉上眼睛，緩慢地深呼吸。把注意力集中在肺部。"/pause 3000/speak Emily "想像每次吸氣時，純淨的能量都流入你的身體。#$b#呼氣時，感受所有緊張與負面能量流出，讓每一次呼吸都使你更加放鬆。"/pause 3000/speak Emily "現在，向石頭的振動頻率敞開心扉。有感覺到什麼嗎？"/pause 1000/textAboveHead Abigail "沒有。"/pause 2000/textAboveHead Marnie "我有！"/pause 2000/textAboveHead Caroline "很放鬆"/pause 4000/emote Haley 24/pause 1000/emote Haley 24 true/viewport move 1 -1 7000/pause 4000/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/message "看來寶石確實派上用場了……"/end

sadpiano/12 5/farmer 10 11 0 Alex 13 5 0/skippable/pause 500/speak Alex "*嘆氣*$s"/doAction 10 9/move farmer 0 -5 1/move farmer 3 0 0/pause 500/faceDirection Alex 2/pause 600/speak Alex "哦，嗨，@。$s"/faceDirection Alex 0/move farmer 1 0 0/move farmer 0 -1 3/emote farmer 8/pause 500/emote Alex 28/speak Alex "看看這些書。我一本都沒讀過。一想到要翻開其中一本就緊張。$s#$b#但在這世界上，沒腦袋就無法過上像樣的生活……$s"/faceDirection Alex 1/speak Alex "$q 57 null#我真沒用……$s#$r 57 0 Event_books1#別胡說。你是個天才！#$r 57 50 Event_books2#每個人都有長處和短處。#$r 57 -50 Event_books3#沒用？對，差不多就是這樣。"/faceDirection Alex 0/pause 1000/emote Alex 16/speak Alex "但我不會放棄！$a"/faceDirection Alex 1/speak Alex "只要努力，我什麼都做得到！"/jump farmer/pause 800/speak Alex "嘿，也許不久後的某一天，我們可以邊吃晚餐邊討論……哲、學。你們聰明人聊的不就是這些嗎？$h"/faceDirection farmer 2/animate farmer false true 100 102 103/pause 2000/globalFade/viewport -1000 -1000/stopAnimation farmer/end

distantBanjo/-1000 -1000/farmer 50 24 1 Sam 53 24 0/addConversationTopic samJob1 2/skippable/makeInvisible 52 24/makeInvisible 51 24/makeInvisible 50 24/viewport -100 -100 true unfreeze/pause 3000/emote Sam 28/pause 500/move farmer 2 0 1/emote farmer 8/faceDirection Sam 3/pause 400/speak Sam "哦，嘿，@。你看起來在外面忙了很久！"/pause 100/faceDirection Sam 0/emote Sam 40/pause 500/speak Sam "嘿，我剛才在想……$s#$b#你知道嗎，我真的很喜歡和你住在這裡。我是說……我愛死了！#$b#但我覺得自己變得很懶。每天只是漫無目的地閒晃。$s"/pause 500/emote farmer 20/faceDirection Sam 3/speak Sam "哦，我知道你不介意！農場賺的錢夠多，我其實不必工作，而且真的很感激！#$b#但我想感覺自己也對某件事有所貢獻……明白我的意思嗎？"/faceDirection Sam 0/pause 400/speak Sam "所以……我想試著找份工作……和音樂有關的工作。#$b#那一直都是我的最愛！$h#$b#哦，呃……當然，除了你以外！$8#$b#嘿嘿……$10"/faceDirection Sam 3/speak Sam "總之……有消息我會告訴你！"/emote farmer 32/pause 500/end

jaunty/-1000 -1000/farmer -10 -10 0 Demetrius 6 21 3 Robin 5 21 1/skippable/showFrame Demetrius 28/viewport 6 21 true/pause 900/speak Robin "德米特里厄斯，我沒叫你買番茄。我說的是水果。"/emote Demetrius 8/speak Demetrius "我不明白。番茄就是水果！"/emote Robin 12/speak Robin "一般人說想要水果時，絕對不是在指番茄。科學分類根本不重要。"/warp farmer 6 24/playSound doorClose/pause 500/showFrame Demetrius 29/faceDirection Robin 2/speak Demetrius "@！很高興你來了。你可以替這場爭論作個了結。"/move farmer 0 -2 0/emote farmer 8/speak Demetrius "$q 59 null#你會把番茄歸為哪一類？#$r 59 -30 Event_tomato1#蔬菜#$r 59 50 Event_tomato2#水果"/pause 500/showFrame Demetrius 28/speak Demetrius "我只是希望你能理解我的觀點。#$b#你告訴我某件事時，我很難確切知道該作哪些假設。"/pause 300/faceDirection Robin 1/pause 300/speak Demetrius "但我會努力改進。"/pause 600/emote Robin 20/pause 300/showFrame Demetrius 29/pause 600/speak Demetrius "謝謝你幫忙，@。$h"/pause 800/end

records.translation: playful/-1000 -1000/farmer 27 19 1 Sam 36 20 1 Sebastian 37 19 2 Harvey 39 19 2 Shane 40 17 2 Elliott 41 19 2 Alex 42 20 3/animate Shane false true 200 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 20 21 22 23 24 24 24 24 23 22 21 20 20 20 20/pause 1000/message "不知為什麼，你決定把手伸進口袋……"/pause 500/message "你摸到兔子的腳，頓時鬆了一口氣……"/move farmer 5 0 1 true/viewport 37 19 true/move false/pause 500/faceDirection Sam 3 true/faceDirection Elliott 3 true/faceDirection Harvey 3 true/faceDirection Alex 3 true/faceDirection Shane 3 true/faceDirection Sebastian 3 true/textAboveHead Sam "嘿！"/textAboveHead Alex "最近怎樣？"/textAboveHead Shane "哦，嘿"/pause 2000/move farmer 3 0 1/emote farmer 32/pause 500/speak Harvey "你正好趕上第一屆鵜鶘鎮8號球錦標賽！"/pause 500/speak Elliott "別擔心，我以前也從沒玩過。$h"/pause 500/speak Shane "很簡單，只要給母球抹點芥末醬……$h"/pause 500/fade/viewport -1000 -1000/pause 1500/message "你和男士們打了一局撞球。"/pause 1000/message "塞巴斯蒂安當然贏了……不過還是非常好玩！"/pause 500/end

continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Evelyn 64 18 0/skippable/pause 1500/speak Evelyn "早安，親愛的。"/pause 500/faceDirection Evelyn 3/pause 500/faceDirection Evelyn 2/speak Evelyn "一路散步過來真舒服……我已經很久沒見到這座老農場了。$s#$b#看起來甚至比記憶中更棒！$h"/pause 500/faceDirection Evelyn 3/faceDirection Evelyn 0/pause 500/speak Evelyn "來，我帶了一點東西給你。#$b#這是禮物……一位園丁送給另一位園丁的禮物。$h"/pause 800/itemAboveHead pot/playSound getNewSpecialItem/pause 3300/awardFestivalPrize pot/pause 200/message "收到了「花園盆」"/pause 800/speak Evelyn "這些盆子非常方便。你可以用它們在室內種植任何季節的作物！#$b#放在室外也很好看……不過在外面只能種當季作物。"/pause 500/speak Evelyn "需要更多的話，做起來也很簡單……來，我有張剪自舊雜誌的說明。"/pause 200/playSound getNewSpecialItem/addCraftingRecipe Garden Pot/pause 500/message "學會製作「花園盆」"/pause 800/speak Evelyn "好了，我最好回去了。喬治如果沒準時吃到燕麥粥就會不高興……#$b#祝你今天過得愉快，親愛的！$h"/pause 500/end
